findings.title: Unbounded repeated replacement construction before FileService byte gate
findings.detail: Up to10000 matches times a newline-normalized replacement of524288 UTF16 units can request billions of units before FileService enforces262144 bytes. Observed RangeError rather than bounded FILE_TOO_LARGE. Potential smaller huge joins can allocate far beyond the file ceiling.

reproduction.note: Probe exit0 means observation completed, not a passed product expectation. The corresponding30th regression then failed.

findings.recommendation: Reject projected UTF16 result length greater than this.files.maxBytes before split/join. This is a safe lower bound on UTF8 bytes; retain existing FileService byte check for bounded constructed strings. Avoid naive UTF8 subtraction because JS half-surrogate search/replacement can change pairing across boundaries.
findings.regression: Known projected output above buffer.constants.MAX_STRING_LENGTH yields safe immediate RangeError in unguarded join; require FILE_TOO_LARGE, preserved source bytes and no staging.

reviewedProperties: First-newline regex prioritizes CRLF and uses os.EOL only when no delimiter exists, matching pinned helper on supported platforms.
Only search and replacement normalized; original file and unmatched mixed delimiters remain byte-exact.
String replacement remains literal through split/join; dollar metacharacters are not interpreted.
Normalized search remains nonempty; existing nonoverlapping count and10000-match work bound preserved explicitly.
Added cancellation check after asynchronous read correctly gives cancellation precedence over no-match or success.
Shared FileService versioned atomic write, policy/root/private/link checks and separate write permission remain.
No new dependencies, network telemetry, credentials, authority expansion or format claims.

Direct fixtures cover CRLF/LF/CR, first-style mixed data, native fallback, BOM/Unicode/literal bytes, counts, no-match, schema, exact byte limits, write capability, policy, links, conflicts, and cancellation.

Installed harness has real child-tool discovery, normalized edit persisted bytes, errors, exact262144-byte/one-over cases, private/outside denials and read-only restart. Actual packed run is not claimed by this static review.
Full DCP025 remains open: fuzzy/Office matching, overlap semantics, success-preview and wider contract/client evidence remain separate.
